cohort: 182 un-booked obstetric patients aged 18 to 35 years presenting at Sheikh Zaid Hospital Rahim Yar Khan, excluding those >35 years old, with systemic diseases, ruptured uterus, or 2+ C-sections.
finding: A high percentage of un-booked obstetric patients underwent C-sections.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with education status, but not with age, income status, area of residence, or parity.
